Release 2.1.1

macOS: on first launch, right-click the app and choose Open.
Windows: on first launch, SmartScreen may warn — choose More info, then Run anyway.

## Changes

- feat: add commit display and sorting in PR overview timeline

- feat: implement related context file collection from direct imports in AI review
- feat: add 'corrected' validity status to discussion points and update related logic
